description: Empirical solid mass-yield and energy-densification-ratio (EDR) curves vs torrefaction temperature (np.interp). Energy yield = mass yield x EDR. Numbers reused from EC146 F1b (Bach 2017).
source: Bach & Skreiberg (2016) Renew. Sustain. Energy Rev.; Bates & Ghoniem (2012) — reused from EC146 F1b

yield_curves.comment: Solid mass yield (frac of dry feed) and EDR (energy densification ratio = torrefied LHV / raw LHV) vs temperature.
